catalog.live_scope: The smoke run checks agent lookup and missing-agent errors, model catalog/default envelopes, repeated type filters, grouping, empty results and location selection.
unverified: Null default-model data is mock-tested, not observed live. Remote-provider readiness and concurrent catalog changes are not covered. The separate active fixture explicitly selects its configured localhost provider.

discovery.live_scope: The smoke run checks location directory encoding/overrides, header fallback and query precedence, plus typed agent lists and resolved location metadata.
unverified: Explicit-null location query semantics and other location variants.

events.live_scope: The smoke run checks independent filtered SSE subscriptions, connected markers, typed rename/inbox events, exclusion and continued delivery after another stream is dropped. Permission/form/fork profiles add their lifecycle events. The active fixture (2026-11-03) adds gated text deltas, execution outcomes and real tool lifecycle events from a scripted localhost provider. Controlled recovery runs the shared background observer through transport cuts, missed text/form events, a captured history response delayed across settlement, and explicit reconnect/refresh; the unfiltered feed now decodes instruction hashes correctly.
source_reviewed: The pinned global feed is live-only, sends heartbeat comments and uses a bounded subscriber queue.
unverified: Heartbeat timing, server slow-consumer overflow, restart/remote-network recovery and general snapshot/event ordering under concurrent or continuous writers. The live fixture establishes convergence only after controlled execution settles; it does not run the example CLI timer/backoff loop.

execution.live_scope: The smoke run checks interrupt on idle/parked sessions, including omitted/false/true resume, interrupted:false, unchanged held input, idle wait HTTP 204 and missing-session errors. The active fixture (2026-11-03) verifies interrupted:true during a gated local provider stream, provider connection cancellation, local wait timeout without stopping execution, final wait settlement, and matching success/failure/interrupted session and history outcomes.
source_reviewed: The pinned message updater projects terminal execution outcomes into idle history (except shutdown interruption), and instruction changes into marked system notices. The automation classifier is mock-tested, not live execution evidence.
unverified: Active tool interruption, repeated interrupts while stopping, steering/successor execution, concurrent wakeups, cross-server ownership and remote providers. The complete automation policy remains mock-tested.

fork.live_scope: The smoke run forks imported settled transcripts: exclusive/before-first/default/null boundaries, errors, configuration/location inheritance, new message IDs, attachments, reset state, parked-input exclusion, compaction remapping, events and independent deletion.
source_reviewed: The pinned import path drops unfinished assistant/shell/compaction entries before storing fixtures.
unverified: Fork filtering during real active execution, instruction inheritance, concurrent mutation, copies crossing the 500-row batch boundary and retained-log replay on forks.

forms.live_scope: Manual forms cover six field kinds, location/session isolation, create/list/get, ID conflicts, answer/default/condition validation, reply/cancel terminal states, feedback and typed lifecycle events. Invalid answers remain pending. The active fixture (2026-11-03) answers a real waiting question and cancels another with feedback; the provider validates the tool result and execution continues. Tool/form events, running/terminal snapshots and pending lists are asserted. The shared observer recovers a form created while disconnected and clears its stale pending snapshot after an answer/completion missed during another disconnect.
source_reviewed: The pinned service retains terminal forms in memory for ten minutes.
The pinned question tool treats dismissal without feedback differently from cancellation with model-facing feedback; only the feedback path is active-tested.
unverified: Timed eviction, restart/teardown, concurrent replies and question dismissal without feedback. Active calls target a scripted localhost provider; external URLs are never opened.

history.live_scope: The smoke run reads imported settled messages with attachments, reasoning/tool content, both cursor directions, type filters, ordering conflicts, empty pages and missing/wrong-session errors. Raw import is fixture setup, not a public SDK method. The active fixture (2026-11-03) reads incomplete assistant and running tool snapshots, then completed/failed tools and terminal history. A text delta arrives while the stored text part is empty; final/interrupted text is retained after settlement. Controlled recovery verifies that an unfinished block cannot be reconstructed after missing a delta, but final history is recovered after settlement; delayed older responses are invalidated and refreshed without patching or duplicating text.
source_reviewed: The pinned message updater stores text on text.ended, not transient text.delta; live previews must remain separate from stored history.
unverified: Concurrent timeline changes during pagination and experimental media-reference negotiation. Remote-provider behavior and arbitrary tool histories remain unverified.

inbox.live_scope: The smoke run uses resume(false) on idle sessions: prompt admission and ID reconciliation, prepared inline attachments, pending order, steer-to-queue updates, cancellation, conflicts and absent history before delivery. The active fixture (2026-11-03) admits an identified resume(true) prompt in each fresh session, observes delivery and execution through a scripted local provider, then checks matching user history and empty inbox after settlement.
source_reviewed: Omitted/null resume wakes execution; queue delivery alone does not prevent it. Updating queued input to steer wakes execution.
unverified: Delivery during an already active run, delivered/cancelled ID reuse, concurrent admissions, synthetic/compaction/move lifecycles and experimental media negotiation.

log.live_scope: The smoke run checks stock-CLI marker-only behavior and finite/follow modes. Captured rename events explicitly seeded into the runner-owned database verify exclusive replay, cross-aggregate isolation, follow, resumption and watermark gaps.
source_reviewed: The v2.2.5 CLI disables log payload retention; the replay fixture does not change that server policy.
unverified: Naturally retained payloads across restart, fork replay and retention under load. Seeded rows do not establish durable recovery guarantees.

permissions.live_scope: Manually created idle-session requests exercise allow/deny/ask, pending lists and ownership, location isolation, once/reject/always replies, saved-rule effects across sessions, deny precedence, feedback and asked/replied events. The active fixture (2026-11-03) discovers a real waiting read by session/location and tool ID, replies once, and verifies the file content reaches the local provider, the tool completes and execution succeeds.
source_reviewed: Duplicate pending-ID rejection is source-reviewed only.
unverified: Reject/always and feedback with actual waiting tools, plugin hooks, concurrent replies/partial failures and reload/restart behavior. Saved-rule smoke fixtures use only the disposable database.

selection.live_scope: The smoke run checks stored agent/model selection, history markers, deduplication, default variant normalization, unknown IDs and missing sessions.
unverified: Availability/credentials for a selected model or agent, selection during execution and concurrent catalog changes.

server.live_scope: The v2.2.5 disposable smoke run asserts version/PID/paths, successful Basic authentication and typed unauthenticated HTTP 401.
unverified: Pairing/session cookies and proxy-specific authentication.

sessions.live_scope: The smoke run checks create/get/list/update/remove with idle disposable sessions: null/omitted inputs, location and parent behavior, cursor traversal, filtering, metadata/permission replacement, archive/restore and recursive deletion.
source_reviewed: The pinned title generator can call a model for populated sessions; updates are sequential rather than an atomic transaction.
unverified: Generated titles on populated sessions, deletion during active work, concurrent page consistency, maximum list limits and all project/subpath filters.

workspace.live_scope: Verified locally on macOS arm64 and in Linux x86-64 hosted run 42707625108 at 88224a1, 2026-11-09, with v2.2.5: list/find, special-character file names, binary bytes, 206 ranges, ETag/Last-Modified 304, 416, missing files, Git branch/status/working and committed diff, base envelope and worktree listing.
source_reviewed: Pinned fs handler confinement and single-range/conditional handling; VCS provider initialization and server branch limits. The first VCS snapshot can precede asynchronous provider activation.
unverified: remote workspaces/providers, symlink escape responses, malformed/multiple ranges, changing files during streaming, nonempty inferred review bases, branch-mode/remote-branch diffs and multi-worktree inventories.

ptys.live_scope: Verified locally on macOS arm64 and in Linux x86-64 hosted run 42707625108 at 88224a1, 2026-11-09, with v2.2.5: create/list/get, location isolation, accepted rename/resize, ticket lifetime, explicit removal, missing PTY errors and retained exit code. No provider calls or user shells are used.
source_reviewed: PTY default shell/login argument behavior, server environment inheritance, resize only for running PTYs, bounded exited retention and ticket header/origin/location checks.
unverified: actual viewport dimensions after resize, user-shell behavior, ticket expiry timing, cross-workspace ticket isolation and server restart/process recovery.

pty-socket.live_scope: Verified locally on macOS arm64 and in Linux x86-64 hosted run 42707625108 at 88224a1, 2026-11-09, with v2.2.5 and the websocket feature: ticket connection/reuse rejection, initial cursor, UTF-8 input/output, explicit detach with process retained, cursor reconnect and exited-PTY close code 4404.
source_reviewed: Pinned ordinary PTY protocol: HTTP 101, single-use 60-second tickets, text output, NUL-prefixed binary JSON cursor after replay, UTF-16 cursor units, bounded retained output with no replay-gap marker and disconnect without process removal.
unverified: TLS/proxy deployment, restart/reconnect across servers, replay-buffer eviction, slow consumers and ticket expiry timing. Invalid handshakes/control frames, bounded errors, message limits and read cancellation/deadlines are deterministic protocol tests.

workspace-lifecycle.live_scope: Verified on macOS arm64 and Linux x86-64, 2026-11-09, with v2.2.5: Git init, unknown-provider rejection and existing-repository conflict; detached worktree create, authoritative/suffixed paths, clean removal, dirty removal refused with forceRequired before explicit forced fixture cleanup, external-worktree discovery and stale-row removal via refresh, root-checkout rejection and missing-project errors. Linux smoke/active run 42713795590 passed at 3ff1edb.
source_reviewed: Canonical project configuration/plugin activation, selected worktree strategy, optional source/parent/name/revision, setup scripts after checkout persistence, partial effects on failure, refresh tolerating strategy discovery errors, and explicit force behavior.
unverified: custom strategies/providers and Mercurial, setup-script failure/side effects, permission failures, concurrent operations, remote/network filesystems, nested repositories and arbitrary force policies.

session-workflows.live_scope: Verified on macOS arm64 and Linux x86-64 with pinned v2.2.5 on 2026-11-09: configured command/skill catalogs, missing/failing callbacks, successful command admission and scripted local execution, real Git snapshot diffs, history-only/file reverts and restoration, busy rejection, clearing a revert waking parked work, compaction auto-commit/admission/completion/context and permanent inclusive history deletion. Linux smoke/active run 42713795590 passed at 3ff1edb.
source_reviewed: Command callbacks await plugin activation and can mutate/submit work; 204 is callback completion. Compaction commits staged history before admission and wakes execution. Clearing a revert wakes queued execution; moving/clearing file stages can overwrite later file edits. Commit deletes inclusive projected history and matching inbox/media references. Diff turn and cross-location rules follow the pinned service.
unverified: arbitrary plugins/commands, real providers, native compaction, cross-location ranges, concurrent writers, snapshot capture/restore failures and large histories. File diffs use a controlled harness write during a gated provider step, not a model-selected edit tool.

saved-permissions.live_scope: Verified on macOS arm64 and Linux x86-64 with v2.2.5 (2026-11-09): two-project isolation, omitted/header fallback and explicit/empty project filters, nullable/no-op/empty patches, duplicate conflicts, future allow/ask evaluations, pending requests retained across edits, deny precedence, missing updates and repeated removal. Rules are seeded through explicit Always replies in disposable projects; no model or tool is invoked. Linux smoke/active run 42715208158 passed at ea1df6f.
source_reviewed: The list handler defaults omitted projectID to the server location project; the core service treats an empty string as no database filter. Update/remove address global IDs. Optional patch fields use nullish fallback, unique project/action/resource triples conflict, missing removal succeeds, and future evaluations read saved rules without a reload. Mutations do not settle pending requests or cancel active work.
unverified: remote stores, concurrent edits/evaluations, custom permission hooks, active-tool cancellation and restart durability.

session-activity.live_scope: Smoke checks process inactivity, no-idle view, empty parked synthetic input, first-admission reconciliation, cross-session/type conflicts, missing sessions and cancellation. The scripted active fixture checks gated running/idle snapshots, synthetic promotion and consumed reconciliation, two idle watermarks with future/stale/duplicate acknowledgements, viewed events and unchanged time.updated, and staged-revert suppression without committing history.
source_reviewed: Pinned v2.2.5 session/session.ts, inbox.ts, run-coordinator.ts and projector.ts: activity is process ownership through settlement; viewed time is a monotone observed-idle watermark; first matching synthetic admission wins, consumed delivery is reconstructed from the repeated request, cancellation removes pending state, and resume(false) does not pause an existing drain.
unverified: Cross-process ownership, restart recovery, concurrent admissions/viewers and synthetic steering while a drain is already running. Explicit-null defaults and numeric precision are protocol-tested; remote providers and synthetic tool execution are outside the live fixture.

setup-discovery.live_scope: Smoke checks ordered file/virtual configuration documents and directory sources, location overrides, shell candidates, provider list/get equality and missing-provider errors, hidden local references, and project archive filters/recency ordering using fixed owned SQLite rows. Active tests read the scripted localhost provider and config, check Debug redaction against its ephemeral credential, and assert discovery makes no provider requests.
source_reviewed: Pinned v2.2.5 config.ts/discovery.ts: ordered sources are not an effective merged configuration; managed policies and settings have separate ordering. Provider list filters availability after plugin readiness, while get inspects registered definitions. Project list excludes archived by default and sorts active descending/id ascending. Shell acceptable is compatibility, not executability. Reference listing retains hidden entries and can expose unmaterialized Git cache paths.
unverified: Remote providers, unavailable registered-provider lookup, managed/integration configuration, hot reload/concurrent catalog changes, remote Git reference materialization and Windows shell discovery. Archive transitions are not exercised: the owned fixture seeds metadata solely to test read filters and ordering.

shells.live_scope: Verified 2026-11-09 on macOS arm64 and Linux x86-64 at implementation commit 4922533 (CI 42729903511; pinned compatibility 42730417495). The owned smoke fixture runs local commands with zero/nonzero exits, server timeout and explicit removal; checks merged output, running-only lists, retained detail, location overrides, byte cursors, UTF-8 splitting and deleted capture files; verifies session shell started/ended events, message history, parked synthetic completion, environment replacement including empty maps, and completion after a local HTTP timeout.
source_reviewed: OpenCode v2.2.5 core shell service: zero disables the millisecond timeout, 25 exited records per location, seven-day capture-file retention sweep, output flush before terminal status, independent UTF-8 page decoding, and idempotent HTTP removal.

Session shell completion is server-owned after client disconnection; completion queues synthetic input with resume:false. Session environment replaces an in-memory local map; TERM/OPENCODE_TERMINAL are injected, remote workspaces bypass it. The ended-event preview is capped at 1 MiB; synthetic notifications use a bounded tail.
unverified: Windows, remote workspace execution, plugin overrides, retention eviction/sweep/restart cleanup and concurrent session movement. Zero-length reads of nonempty output can fail on v2.2.5; the fixture uses zero only beyond EOF. HTTP timeout coverage establishes local caller disconnection behavior, not distributed exactly-once execution.

tool-discovery.live_scope: The disposable v2.2.5 smoke fixture checks all six reads and location overrides using owned local plugin directories and stdio MCP servers: five integration methods/shared forms, environment connection status without values, policy-filtered list versus direct lookup, typed missing integration, active/failed/builtin plugins, connected/disabled/failed MCP states, populated sorted resources/templates, unsupported template listing and search registration with web search disabled.
source_reviewed: Integration listing awaits plugin activation and applies a policy filter; direct lookup does neither. Other inventories are current snapshots. MCP catalog reads contact connected servers and may retry/recover or omit failed sources.
unverified: Real OAuth/credential flows, remote MCP authentication/recovery, package updates, dynamic plugin reload and concurrent catalogs. Pending/needs-auth, credential descriptors, package/SDK sources and absent plugin IDs are protocol-tested only.

credentials.live_scope: Disposable v2.2.5 fixtures exercise global storage of dummy key/OAuth/external values, cross-location listing, first-credential activation despite activate:false, preserved selection, explicit activation, rename, duplicate-ID conflict, deletion fallback and missing-ID no-ops. Owned plugin methods exercise key/external connections with form metadata, omitted/null/default/empty labels and location overrides, plus policy, form, method and integration errors. All dummy credentials are removed.

live_tests.label: owned credential lifecycle and direct connections

source_reviewed: Credential creation uses global config policy without requiring a registered integration; direct methods use location registry/policy without awaiting plugin activation. Key/external methods validate forms and store values/references without checking provider access or resolving external secrets.
unverified: Real credentials/providers, token refresh/revocation, OAuth and command attempt lifecycles, cross-process persistence, concurrent writers and active model/provider effects of selection changes. Mock tests cover malformed values, strict inputs, diagnostic redaction, byte bounds and no retries.
